turns.doctor_question: Hi, welcome in. I'm Dr. [Name]. To start, can you tell me what brings you in to see me today?
turns.patient_response: Hi, Doctor. Well, I guess what brings me in is... I've been having these times where I just eat, and after I do it, I just sit there looking at all the empty containers. I feel really disgusted with myself. I've always tried to be a steady, in-control man. But when I'm sitting there looking at what I just did, I feel like I'm not that guy at all.

symptom_reasoning.S055: The patient explicitly states that after eating episodes, he sits looking at the empty containers and feels really disgusted with himself.

turns.doctor_question: After one of these eating episodes, do you ever try to get rid of the food or make up for it—like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot?
turns.patient_response: No, I... no, I don't do any of that. I don't try to throw it up or take laxatives or anything like that. And with my job driving all day, I definitely don't exercise to make up for it. I just kind of sit there with it, feeling awful.

symptom_reasoning.S047: The patient explicitly denies engaging in non-purging compensatory behaviors such as exercising to make up for eating episodes.
symptom_reasoning.S048: The patient explicitly denies purging behaviors, stating they do not throw up or use laxatives.

turns.doctor_question: How often would you say these episodes of eating and feeling out of control happen—like, how many times a week or month?
turns.patient_response: Well, since I've been stuck at home with this back injury... it's been happening a lot more. I'd say it happens several nights most weeks. Honestly, I can't think of a single week in the last three months where I didn't have at least one of those episodes. It's pretty constant right now.

turns.doctor_question: During these episodes, would you say you're eating a much larger amount of food in a short period of time than most people would eat in similar circumstances?
turns.patient_response: Yeah, definitely. I mean... some evenings I’ll heat up what I swear is just going to be one bowl of pozole. But before I know it, I’ve gone through the whole pot. Then I'm eating a couple of tamales, chips, and whatever other leftovers are just sitting there in the fridge. It's like I’m feeding a whole crew instead of just myself. So, yeah, it's a lot of food in a short amount of time.

symptom_reasoning.S049: The patient explicitly confirms eating an unusually large amount of food in a short period of time, describing consuming an entire pot of pozole, tamales, chips, and leftovers as if feeding a whole crew.
